problem: Emergency preparedness was too easy to mark as documented because the 16 planning standards were not first-class rows.
concrete_next_change: Use nuclear-ep-16-planning-standard-crosswalk.csv as the required checklist for any emergency-preparedness maturity upgrade.
acceptance_test: 16/16 standards have evidence references, owners, exercise status and no open P0 gaps.
risk_if_not_done: A green scorecard hides failure against a binding planning standard.

problem: Universal 262-gate crossproduct inflated every emergency floor and made non-applicable gaps look real.
concrete_next_change: Use sparse binding_gate_ids in nuclear-service-floor-map.csv and sparse evaluation view for the 30 emergency floors.
acceptance_test: Emergency preparedness floors have 4-24 gates each instead of 262; legacy crossproduct is explicitly not source of truth.
risk_if_not_done: Reviewers spend effort on irrelevant gates and miss the real ones.

problem: EPZ assumptions can silently stale while maps still look authoritative.
concrete_next_change: Attach demographic, route, school/LTC/healthcare, carless-household, ingestion-pathway and compound-shock freshness dates to each site.
acceptance_test: No EPZ assumption used in an exercise or scorecard lacks a last-reviewed date and source.
risk_if_not_done: Evacuation or ingestion controls fail on the actual population and network.

problem: KI stockpiles can become false reassurance.
concrete_next_change: Gate KI with the anti-theater checks; make KI unable to close evacuation, shelter, decon, monitoring, food/water, hospital, or recovery gates.
acceptance_test: Every KI claim states authority, trigger, dose/timing, access path, contraindications, and explicit limits.
risk_if_not_done: Public or political messaging treats KI as broad radiation protection.

problem: Recovery is the area most likely to be deferred until after trust collapses.
concrete_next_change: Use the recovery ladder to require pre-authorized reentry, relocation, cleanup, food/water, population monitoring, claims, and counterevidence paths.
acceptance_test: Each phase has entry criteria, decisions, evidence, affected-public protections and closeout blockers.
risk_if_not_done: Communities are evacuated or relocated without credible return, compensation, or health-follow-up path.

problem: New-reactor emergency planning may be misread as an exemption from offsite readiness.
concrete_next_change: Create a 50.160 branch that records performance objectives, quarterly metrics, initial exercise evidence, EPZ basis and ingestion response.
acceptance_test: Every SMR/non-LWR/NPUF readiness claim declares whether 50.47(b) or 50.160 applies and why.
risk_if_not_done: Advanced reactor siting debates confuse risk-informed EP with no EP.

problem: Population monitoring and reception-center throughput are easy to under-size.
concrete_next_change: Add site-level throughput estimates for registration, screening, decontamination, privacy, medical referral and family reunification.
acceptance_test: Exercise measures people/hour, staff hours, bottlenecks, privacy failures and referral capacity.
risk_if_not_done: People self-disperse without monitoring, tracking, decontamination, or follow-up.

problem: Alerting can pass a siren test while failing people.
concrete_next_change: Score public warning by reach and comprehension across sirens, EAS, WEA, phone, door-to-door, language and disability access.
acceptance_test: Alert test reports include non-English, disabled, carless/no-phone and institutional populations.
risk_if_not_done: Technical success hides functional notification failure.

problem: Exercises can become theater when AAR findings remain open.
concrete_next_change: Tie exercise outcomes to corrective-action owner, due date, retest requirement and public-safe closure evidence.
acceptance_test: No maturity upgrade if material AAR findings remain open past due.
risk_if_not_done: The organization rehearses failure without repairing it.

problem: Ingestion-pathway controls are slower and more jurisdictionally distributed than plume actions.
concrete_next_change: Pre-map farms, dairies, water intakes, labs, embargo authorities, alternate water and producer compensation.
acceptance_test: Ingestion exercise demonstrates sample-to-decision timing and public communications.
risk_if_not_done: Food/water controls arrive after products have moved and public trust is lost.
